notes.title: Update

This is the first part of a large update, and mainly consists of a change of CG's and extending the story.

Various other fixes have been added as well.

The next part will consist of translated text for Japanese players, most likely new achievements and a new character graphic

notes.title: Update news
notes.notes:
What should be the penultimate set of CG has now been completed, and edit for the extra bits of the story is nearly complete.

I'm hoping the updated version will be available sometime before March

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
A pretty large update has been started for Relentless Protagonist.  Besides update CGs (with some new ones as well), the story has been updated and various new graphics have been introduced as well.

I'm hoping this will be available in the first quarter of 2025

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Whilst I'm waiting for various things to do with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981690/WTC__Loves_Labours_Lost/]WTC : Love's Labour's Lost[/url] I have started on updating WTC : Relentless Protagonist

So far the following has been implemented :

[list]
[*] New prologue/skip to chapter #1 graphics
[*] New options to skip some of the prologue (new achievements here)
[*] Dialogue has been modified to allow easy translation (which is probably will be)
[/list]

notes.title: Future update
notes.notes:
I have started the process of updating this visual novel, with various parts being extended and/or change - notably Mrs. Jinx visit to the protagonist's parents home has been rewritten.

The restaurant manager's fate will be a bit more detailed too.

Some of the CGs will be replaced, and I'm looking to get this done by September/October with any luck.

notes.title: Update is here
notes.notes:
This update contains :

[list]
[*] Fixed various text problems
[*] Some new graphics added
[*] New route later on in the game that can lead to a long discussion with ex-class president, and further developments with Grendel

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
This update removes a check for system locale which is a problem with some operating systems.

In addition, a new "Cheat" option has been added for those unable to buy "Recruitment Day".  Complete the game once, and go into Preferences.  In there will be a "Cheat" option, which will mark "Recruitment Day" and gain you the achievement.
